description:
Moon Gate Near The Tower Of Reflection. Garden Of The Humble Administrator, Suzhou.
Three typical features of Chinese gardens are seen here: pierced lattice windows, an up-and-down curving "dragon" wall, and a circular "moon gate" that frames the walking path.

title: File:苏州沧浪亭的竹子.jpg
author: Acot一杯茶
description: ​苏州沧浪亭早在约公元十一世纪的宋代便已建立，是一座幽静的园林建筑。从十一世纪直到十九世纪的清代，沧浪亭几经易手，如今现存的建筑则主要为清代遗存。园内遍植绿竹，即使在炎热的夏天也毫无暑意。
changes: resized, compressed; display crop / 缩小压缩，展示裁切
location: 沧浪亭 · 竹影木格 / Canglang Pavilion · bamboo through lattice
